statement:
## Statement

The real sequence space
$$\ell^2(\mathbb N,\mathbb R)=\left\{x=(x_n):\sum_{n\in\mathbb N}|x_n|^2<\infty\right\},$$
with its canonical inner product and norm from
[[def-square-summable-family-on-an-arbitrary-index-set]], is complete and
therefore is a real Hilbert space.
exact_match: Real square-summable sequences with canonical inner product/norm are complete, hence Hilbert. No prior ambient Hilbert hypothesis is assumed. Positive versus zero-based indexing is a coordinate relabelling isometry.
weighted_supplier_alternative: lem-ip-weighted-coefficient-spaces-are-hilbert starts from separable real HilbertH0, so takingH0=l2 would not independently discharge l2 completeness. It already declares this exact completeness lemma among its dependencies.
